# V3 Derma Clinic

> V3 Derma Clinic is a skin, hair and laser clinic in Champapet, Hyderabad, India, offering evidence-based dermatology, cosmetic and trichology treatments led by a qualified consultant dermatologist. Treatments follow international dermatology standards.

## Key facts
- Name: V3 Derma Clinic
- Doctor: Dr. O Lakshmi Jhansi — Consultant Dermatologist, Cosmetologist & Trichologist
- Type: Dermatology / skin, hair & laser clinic
- Location: 1st Floor, Shobha Enclave, Green Park Colony, beside HDFC Bank, Champapet Road, Hyderabad – 500079, Telangana, India
- Phone: +91 8897489595
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918897489595
- Email: customer-care@v3dermaclinic.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 5:00 PM–9:00 PM; Sunday 3:00 PM–6:00 PM
- Website: https://v3dermaclinic.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/v3dermaclinic/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@v3dermaclinic
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/Zlhx3UayoD9c45lfk
- Booking: Call 8897489595, WhatsApp, or the appointment form at /contact.html

## Services
- Clinical dermatology: acne, psoriasis, eczema & dermatitis, vitiligo, fungal infections, warts & moles, allergies & urticaria, pigmentation disorders
- Hair treatments: PRP hair therapy, hair fall treatment, dandruff & scalp care, alopecia treatment
- Laser treatments: laser hair reduction (US-FDA approved diode laser), laser scar removal, laser skin resurfacing, laser pigmentation correction, tattoo removal, birthmark treatment
- Cosmetic & aesthetic: chemical peels, anti-aging treatments, dermal fillers, micro-needling / MNRF, HydraFacial, skin brightening
